note: Known-good serving rates per rung. A rung below 80% of baseline is degraded, not noisy -- 0.80 is chosen to catch the ~22% loss serve-arc.cmd attributes to a partial VRAM spill, the quietest real degradation this box produces. Re-baseline ONLY after verifying the rung by other means (placement via ff_census.py, then a deliberate A/B), and ONLY on a server that is FRESH AFTER RESTART (ADR-0041): a burst measurement is valid on a fresh server and meaningless on a poisoned one.  ||  2026-08-30: a baseline is an EPOCH-SCOPED REFERENCE, not demonstrated invariant machine capacity. At least four stable levels have been observed on this rung (106 / 97 / 65 / 27.5). Health is therefore reported as BASELINE EPOCH + OBSERVED RATE + ACCEPTANCE ENVELOPE. ** Do NOT re-baseline merely because a new stable level appears ** -- that would silently redefine capacity to whatever the machine is currently doing and make the gate unfalsifiable. Re-baseline only after verifying the rung by other means.
